Discover the ZARA Nude Collection Discovery Set, featuring four elegant Eau de Parfum fragrances inspired by the delicacy, purity, and luminosity of floral aromas. Each fragrance offers a unique and modern interpretation of femininity, from fresh and subtle notes to warm and captivating accords.

✨ The Collection Includes:

🌿 Fields at Nightfall – Eau de Parfum
A modern woody floral fragrance with an addictive touch. Fresh bergamot meets the luminous sensuality of jasmine sambac, while tonka bean adds creamy warmth and depth. A warm, slightly sweet, and captivating scent.

🪷 Lightly Bloom – Eau de Parfum
Inspired by the delicate beauty of flowers at dawn. Lotus flower brings a fresh aquatic touch, while peony adds velvety floral elegance. Musk completes the fragrance with a soft, warm, and refined trail.

🍐 Deep Garden – Eau de Parfum
A luminous and enveloping fragrance that opens with the juicy freshness of pear, followed by a delicate heart of freesia. Tonka bean adds a creamy warmth, creating a beautifully balanced sweet and fresh scent.

🤍 Nude Bouquet – Eau de Parfum
A delicate bouquet of white flowers that expresses purity and harmony. Bergamot brings a refreshing opening, while jasmine and lotus create an ethereal floral heart. Creamy sandalwood and vanilla add warmth and elegance to the base.

🎁 Set Includes: 4 Eau de Parfum fragrances.

✨ Four distinctive scents in one beautiful discovery set, perfect for exploring different floral moods or gifting to someone special.
